title: Helping Families Affected by the Flores Earthquake, Zayne Bday Distributes 29 Hygiene Kits in Nagekeo
excerpt: Zayne Bday, through Relawan Nusantara, distributed 29 hygiene kits to residents affected by the Flores earthquake in Nagekeo, NTT. Take a look at the action here!
seoTitle: 29 Hygiene Kits for Flores Quake Families - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: Zayne Bday, through Relawan Nusantara, distributed 29 hygiene kits to residents affected by the Flores earthquake in Nagekeo, NTT. See the action here!
html:
Recovery after the earthquake that shook Flores on 15 August 2026 is still a process that affected communities have to go through. Amid efforts to rebuild their lives, meeting basic needs, including personal hygiene supplies, remains important for keeping families healthy and comfortable.

As a form of care for the affected communities, Zayne Bday together with Relawan Nusantara distributed 29 hygiene kits to 29 households (KK) in RT 01 and RT 02 (neighborhood units), Tonggurambang Village, Aesesa District, Nagekeo Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT).

This aid was given to help families meet their personal hygiene needs during the post-disaster recovery period. The availability of hygiene supplies is expected to support the practice of clean and healthy living while easing household spending on daily necessities.

Helping Meet Basic Needs After the Earthquake

For communities affected by disaster, the recovery process is not only about the condition of their homes and the availability of food. Personal hygiene needs also require attention so that families can go about their daily activities more comfortably and stay healthy.

Through this distribution of hygiene kits, 29 families in Tonggurambang Village received hygiene supplies to support Clean and Healthy Living Behavior (Perilaku Hidup Bersih dan Sehat, PHBS).

Though they may seem simple, hygiene supplies play an important role in daily life. Meeting this need helps families keep up their personal hygiene in a post-disaster situation, when household attention and resources have to be divided among many other needs.

Collaboration to Support Community Recovery

The distribution of aid by Zayne Bday together with Relawan Nusantara is an expression of shared care for families who are still going through the recovery process after the Flores earthquake.

This support is expected to help ease the community's daily needs while also bringing care to the beneficiary families. Collaboration among various parties is an important part of ensuring that aid reaches the people who need it.

Post-disaster recovery certainly requires a long process and sustained support from many parties. Attention to residents' basic needs is expected to give the people of Nagekeo renewed spirit to rise again.

Let us together lend a hand and bring new hope to our brothers and sisters affected by the disaster. Come contribute and share your best care, in the hope that communities can go through the recovery period better, look after their families' health, and gradually rebuild their lives.

Luaskan Manfaat
